'''Tsui Choi''' was an [[Aleena]] [[Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order]]<ref name="Ratts jedi" /> during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]], which the Jedi supported as [[Republic Military|military]] [[commander]]s, and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Towards the end of the war<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|III}}</ref> Choi was present on the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], the [[homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee]]s, as it fell under [[Battle of Kashyyyk|attack]] by the Confederacy. Riding atop a [[can-cell]],<ref name="Episode III" /> Choi led a [[Oevvaor jet catamaran]]<ref name="Ratts jedi" /> as they traveled around the [[Wawaatt Archipelago]] before the fighting broke out between Republic and [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]].<ref name="Episode III" /> He<ref name="Ratts jedi" /> was one of several Jedi on planet at that [[time]], as [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos]], and [[Jedi]] Master [[Luminara Unduli]] were all also present in their own capacities as [[Jedi General]]s.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Kashyyyk! Finally on-screen (and not part of a prime time musical variety show special!) Tsui Choi, the Aleena Jedi, is riding the can-cell that leads the Wookiee catamaran into frame here. I think production just called him "Ratts Jedi".|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="Ratts jedi" />}}
Tsui Choi first appeared in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] within the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" /> His name was first used in the canon era of storytelling by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]]. Hidalgo recalled the character being called the "[[Ratts Tyerell|Ratts]] Jedi" behind the scenes.<ref name="Ratts jedi" />
